snippet.title: Dust Raiders - Official Trailer | Release Date: [July 17, 2025]
snippet.description:
In the unforgiving wasteland of Dust Raiders, survival is a ruthless game. After a deadly Sawblade attack leaves you stranded with nothing but scraps, it’s up to you to rebuild your crew, craft powerful vehicles, and reclaim control of the desert’s brutal territories.

Explore four massive, hostile zones, from the barren Eternal Desert to the toxic marshes and abandoned cities. Engage in tactical vehicle combat, make smart choices in a dynamic economy, and unlock new customization options to enhance your ride and crew.

Release Date: July 17 2025
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397450/Dust_Raiders/
